decisions.reason: As a charting bundle for the firm's web-map platform with several early releases, it draws directly on existing GIS software knowledge and is more likely to be improved than withdrawn.

The hierarchical search plugin is closely related to the firm's web-mapping capabilities, but its narrower scope and lower visibility make discontinuation somewhat more plausible if demand proves limited.
This mobile map control component solves a clear usability issue in a core geospatial use case and fits the firm's established mobile and web-GIS competences.
As the flagship GIS platform and a focus of the firm's direction, it is strongly supported by the firm's accumulated know-how, reusable architectures, and partner network.
Mobile field data capture extends the firm's integrated geospatial workflow offering and can be strengthened through its consulting experience and customer feedback loops.

The search extension complements the firm's existing web-map application stack and can be refined through project-based learning, although some overlap with other search functions creates moderate risk.
